Package pe.ask.core.mapper

Class GenericBeanMapper<D,E>

java.lang.Object
pe.ask.core.mapper.GenericBeanMapper<D,E>
Type Parameters:
D - the domain model type
E - the entity model type
All Implemented Interfaces:
EntityMapper<D,E>
public class GenericBeanMapper<D,E> extends Object implements EntityMapper<D,E>
A highly optimized generic mapper for converting between domain models and database entities.

Implements EntityMapper and uses MethodHandles to cache constructors upon initialization, eliminating the overhead of runtime reflection. Note: This default mapper requires public no-args constructors and does not support Java Records.
